notes.title: Mature Content settings
notes.content:
It is now possible to enable character nudity from the game options without having to download an extra patch. Because of this, we have changed the warnings on the game page and community settings.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28609301/1a98a4abdca2be8a768b0ff43d5a9ce55ce2fb39.jpg[/img]

There is NO nudity by default. You have to go into the options menu and switch it on if you want to see it. If you don't, do nothing and your game will not be affected in any way.

And yes, if you choose 'Everyone naked all the time' that means EVERYONE, male and female, and it means ALL THE TIME. This is very silly.

If you use the comedy censorship option, it will be even sillier.

If you want to see ONLY the character you are romancing naked, then select only the top option. Every character will appear nude at least once at some point during their romance path, but not often. 

The nudity options only affect the sprites, not the CGs. This is just a little extra fun. It was available for a while with extra patching, but many people had trouble making it work, so now it's easier to access if you want it.

notes.title: Adult Content patch now available
notes.content:
For those who want to see a bit more (or less) of the characters in this game, please visit the discussion forums for full information and instructions.

The patch comes with additional censorship options which can be toggled on and off at any time.

notes.title: Now Available - New Romance Scenes
notes.content:
Version 1.07 should now be available to all players on the main branch.

This update adds the possibility of a relationship between the female PC and Ashley, and between the male PC and Brendon.

There are also a few extra scenes for the male PC involving Angelo and Aasi.

If you have any questions about accessing the new content, or run into any problems, please post about it on the discussion forums rather than here, because comments here may not get noticed!

notes.title: Minor update (10 May 2017) - Version 1.04
notes.content:
Today's patch includes only minor changes.

- a small adjustment to the size of the name box
- fixed capitalisation error
- small wording change re: yard/garden
- more ways to be awkward about Jane Eyre

For information on upcoming larger additions please visit the Steam discussion forums for this title.
